help.title: ProcessSH Help
help.overview.p1: ProcessSH is a Spotlight-style command launcher for Windows. Type a shell command, press Enter, see the output.
help.overview.p2: It lives in the system tray and stays out of your way until you need it.
help.tip.drag.title: Drag files from Explorer
help.tip.drag.desc: Drag any file into the input field. The path is inserted with proper escaping.
help.tip.app.title: Type an executable path
help.tip.app.desc: If you type the path to a .exe / .lnk / .bat / .cmd, ProcessSH automatically prefixes it with Start-Process.
help.tip.multiline.title: Multi-line commands
help.tip.multiline.desc: Press Shift+Enter to insert a newline, Enter to execute. Useful for multi-line PowerShell scripts.
help.sudo.desc: Check "Run as administrator" before executing a command to receive a UAC prompt.
help.sudo.bullet1: The command runs in a separate elevated pwsh process.
help.sudo.bullet2: Output is not returned in elevated mode.
help.sudo.bullet3: UAC confirmation is required every time (system behavior).
help.aliases.desc: Aliases let you define short names for frequently used commands. They appear first in the completion popup.
help.aliases.custom.desc: Edit this JSON file to add or change aliases. Changes take effect immediately.
